Notes for dev

1 → 2 · Submit
Submit opens the confirm sheet (dim 0.3s, sheet slides up 0.42s). “Yes, submit” fades the processing screen in over 0.45s and starts the graph. “Check again” closes the sheet.
2 · Processing
You 0s → answers 0.6s → details 1.8s → traits 3.0s → energy colors 4.6s → Bommie match 6.0s → lenses + writing rules 7.4s → Report 9.2s. After 10.4s it waits, breathing, until the API returns.
2 → 3 · Report ready
Report node blooms for 1.0s, then the MuMu background is revealed by a circle wipe from the Report node over 0.9s.
3 · MuMu reveal
From the end of the wipe: text fades up at 0.15s, “MU” rows rise at 0.4s and 0.55s, MuMu rises from below at 0.8s with its floor shadow and the MuMu animation (97 frames, 4.0s) plays once, holding on its last frame, the Home pose. Get Started rises when the animation ends, about 4.8s.
3 → 4 · Get Started
Text, name and button fade out (0.25s). MuMu flies and shrinks into the MuMu card on Home (0.75s) while the teal background fades and Home rises in. The tab bar slides up 0.25s later. The flying MuMu is the animation's last frame, scaled to sit exactly on the card's MuMu, then cross-fades into it.
4 → 5 / 6 · Home navigation
“See full report” and the Profile tab push the page in from the right (0.38s) while Home shifts 28% left. Back reverses it. The Daily Notes / Profile tabs switch pages with a 0.26s cross-fade.
6 · Profile build-up card
New card between the personal details and the personality bars, 340 × 452. Title: SF Pro Text Bold 15/18. It replays the same graph in a compact form (about 5.7s, 0.55× the processing timing) every time Profile opens, ending on a teal “Your profile” node that keeps breathing. The replay button restarts it. The status line ends with “Built from 41 signals in your answers”. Use the real count from the user’s report data.
6 → 7 · Full-screen chart
The expand button on the Profile card rotates the phone to landscape (0.56s) and opens the graph full screen, laid out left to right (You → Your profile). It continues from wherever the card's animation was. The back button rotates back to Profile.
7 · Exploring
Pinch or ⌃ + scroll to zoom (0.7× to 4×), drag empty space to move, and use the +, −, fit and replay buttons. Labels stay the same size on screen while zooming. Tapping a dot highlights it with its direct connections and dims the rest. A details panel then slides up from the bottom, full width, with an 80% dark background and blur. Its height follows the text. It shows three parts: the title in bold, a short description (for questions, the question and the user's answer), then “Evidence used” in bold followed by the dots it draws on in regular weight (answers and details show “Feeds into” instead). Close it with × or by tapping empty space. If the panel would cover the tapped dot, the view moves it up.
Reduced motion
No graph wobble, particles, springs or flight; each screen cross-fades instead.
